svg.title: From an idea to a delivery.
svg.desc: Idea / Mission becomes an Owner-approved Plan, then T3 Executor Build with Asst advice when needed, Verify of actual outputs, local tests, static preview, QA and Owner acceptance, and a selected-files Delivery Pack ZIP.

g.data-text: From an idea to a delivery.
Five stages. One reviewed trail of decisions, files and evidence.
Preview covers registered static files. Unknown outcomes are reconciled, never replayed.
